ObjectName.value: Sunset from Shimla

Categories.value: Self-published work|Red sunsets of India|Cityscapes of Shimla

ImageDescription.value:
Shot from the hilly mall road in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh I watched the orange of the sun slowly crawl and blazed the sky red as the sun set. In few moments the sky was a myriad of colors and a happy play of shades.
The distant hills and little huts that quickly lit up and looked like fireflies seemed to make way for the majestic sky. Shimla looked like a princess about to rest.

Credit.value: Own work

Artist.value: Panchali1989
